_note: Hand-kept extras for events. Read by build.py right after data/events.json; no harvest writes this file. 'events' lays fields over a harvested row by uid (image = a path under docs/, page = a motdang page for the carousel, url = the details link). 'add' holds rows a source stated once, kept until their end day; a row is used only when the harvest no longer carries its uid.
